730161] कन्हैया झा, म ख्य अजभयंता (जनमााण) तृतीय MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS (Western Railway) NOTIFICATION Mumbai, the 22nd April, 2026 S.O. 2114(E).— In exercise of the power conferred by clause37A of Section 2 of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 the Central Government hereby notifies “Declaration of Construction of 04 Nos. of Road Over Bridges (ROBs) in lieu of Level Crossings No. 12, 18, 38 (Vadodara-Godhra)section and LC No.17C (Godhra-Ratlam)section of Western Railway as Special Railway Projects for acquisition of land in the State of Gujarat, for providing national infrastructure for public purpose with effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette. The details of location of Road over bridges in lieu of level crossing is as follow- Sr. No. Level Crossing No. Chainage Block section Village Taluka District 1 12 413/14-16 Pilol-Samlaya Savli GIDC / Manjusar Savli Vadodara 2 18 424/12-14 Samlaya- chapaner Gangadiya Savli Vadodara 3 38 457/0-1 Derol- Kharsaliya Kharsaliya Kalol Panchmahal 4 17C 489/6-8 Chanchlav- Sant Road Saliya Morwa Hadaf Panchmahal [F.
